UGA.note: The abstract states nothing on AI rules or an authority.
The abstract concerns TB screening, a health sector system, not general administration.

facts.fact: The Uganda Catholic Medical Bureau authors state that Uganda uses AI-assisted chest X-ray screening (CAD4TB) in TB screening, applying a national threshold of 50 to identify presumptive TB cases.

A retrospective review of 6,000 West Nile X-ray records (2021-2024) reports CAD4TB v7 at the national 50 threshold had 96.3% sensitivity and 98.0% specificity, identifying 181 of 188 GeneXpert-confirmed cases with 274 referrals.

systems.platform: AI-assisted digital chest X-ray, computer-aided diagnosis

UGA.note: CAD4TB is a product used in Uganda; the abstract states no model, dataset or computing built or hosted in the country.
The abstract states nothing on national standards or certification.
